content:
Good puzzle concept.

Validators need to be similar to the tests they are paired with. Validator 1 should be similar to Test 1, etc.

You should include a test case where the vote is a tie..

Goal
* Please change "ten" to "{{10}}".

* Please insert a blank line between paragraphs to improve readability and avoid creating a wall of text.

* Try explaining the rule rather than relying on an example to convey it. Therefore, please add the following explanation (excluding the "-----" lines) before the example:

-----

[[support_percentage]], the percentage of the planet's population which supports a candidate, determines how many representatives vote for that candidate, using the following formula:

[[support_percentage]] / 10, rounded down

Any representatives that are not assigned to a candidate vote {{Revote}} instead.

-----

* Please start a new paragraph with "After all the votes…"

* For clarity, please change "with the majority wins" to "wins if they receive strictly more than half of all representatives' votes".

Input
* Please insert "space-separated" between "Two" and "integers".

* Please add "Next" before "n lines".

* Please include the variable name [[support_percentage]] in the final description.

Constraints
* Please rewrite this section as follows:

1 ≤ [[n]] ≤ 200
2 ≤ [[c]] ≤ 200
1 ≤ each candidate's name ≤ 20
Each candidate's name does not contain any spaces.
All candidates' names are unique.
0 ≤ [[support_percentage]] ≤ 100
sum of [[support_percentage]] for a planet = 100

Stub generator
* Please change Line 2 to:
loopline c name:word(20)

* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Cases
* Reorder Test/Validator 4 so that it appears before Test/Validator 3.

* Please make sure all candidates' names are unique in each case. Currently,

  • Aileen appears twice in Revote (Test 3).

  • Lenna appears twice in Lots of Candidates (Test 5).

* Each test and its corresponding validator should cover the same scenario, with similar inputs and outputs. Therefore, please revise the cases as follows:

  • One world (Validator 1): Reduce c to below 10. Revise the case so that the output is not "Revote".

  • Insert a new pair of simple cases after Pair 1, where n = 1, c < 10 and the output is "Revote".

  • Several Worlds (Validator 2): Reduce n to around 4 (it need not be exactly 4).

  • Replace Too Many Candidates (Validator 5) with Revote (Test 3).

  • Revote (Test 3): Create a new test where n is around 3, c is around 21 and the output is "Revote".

  • Too Many Planets (Validator 6): Please revise the case so that the output is not "Revote".

* Please create a new pair of cases where n is around 50 and c is around 120 and the output is not "Revote" (if the input is still within the character limit under the said parameters; otherwise, reduce n and/or c as appropriate).

Thanks.
